```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`AutoResearch()` and `MetaHarness()` *(both experimental)* put an LLM agent
in charge of proposing edits to a multi-module dsprrr program, while dsprrr
keeps strict control of candidate validation, evaluation, budgets, checkpoints,
and final selection.

When should you reach for a harness over `GEPA()` or `MIPROv2()`? When
improving a pipeline requires **coordinated edits across multiple steps** (such
as changing both an extractor's output contract and a downstream answerer's
template together), or when letting the proposer run exploratory R analyses on
failures in a sandbox helps it form better hypotheses.

## `AutoResearch()` vs `MetaHarness()`

Both harnesses edit the exact same surface—`instructions` and `template` fields
on editable leaf modules—and never edit R source code or the evaluator. They
differ in how the proposer session is structured:

| Aspect | `AutoResearch()` | `MetaHarness()` |
|---|---|---|
| Proposer session | **One persistent session** that remembers prior hypotheses and outcomes | **Fresh stateless clone** on every iteration, reading a host-saved frontier |
| Proposals per iteration | One candidate edit at a time | A bounded batch (`max_candidates_per_iteration`) |
| Best suited for | Iterative hypothesis refinement where conversational continuity helps | Broad exploration without context drift or stale reasoning |

```text
AutoResearch:  proposer (persistent chat) <-> host eval & ledger (keep / branch / stop)

MetaHarness:   saved frontier -> fresh proposer clone -> batch of edits -> host eval & frontier update
```

> **Note on the offline runner:** To execute both journeys end-to-end during
> documentation builds without API keys or external sandbox binaries, the
> walkthrough below uses deterministic local Chat fixtures (`sandbox = FALSE`,
> loaded in a hidden setup chunk). Live sandboxed examples for both harnesses
> appear at the end of the page.

## 1. The two-step QA pipeline

Our starting pipeline answers factual questions in two steps: `find_evidence`
quotes the context, and `answer_from_evidence` returns the first word of that
evidence. Fixing only step 1 improves single-word answers (`2021`, `18`,
`Thursday`) but still truncates multi-word answers (`"7 business days"` →
`"7"`). Solving every row requires a coordinated edit to both steps.

```{r}
#| label: task-and-data
#| message: false
library(dsprrr)

trainset <- data.frame(
  context = c(
    "The North Hall opened in 2018.",
    "Refunds are processed in 5 business days.",
    "The Kyoto office employs 12 analysts.",
    "Support is available every Tuesday."
  ),
  question = c(
    "Which year did North Hall open?",
    "How long do refunds take?",
    "How many analysts work in Kyoto?",
    "Which weekday is support available?"
  ),
  answer = c("2018", "5 business days", "12", "Tuesday")
)

valset <- data.frame(
  context = c(
    "The Cedar lab opened in 2021.",
    "Standard returns are completed in 7 business days.",
    "The Porto office employs 18 staff.",
    "Releases ship every Thursday."
  ),
  question = c(
    "Which year did Cedar lab open?",
    "How long do standard returns take?",
    "How many staff work in Porto?",
    "Which weekday do releases ship?"
  ),
  answer = c("2021", "7 business days", "18", "Thursday")
)

holdout <- data.frame(
  context = c(
    "The Field team launched in 2016.",
    "Replacement parts arrive in 3 business days.",
    "The Tallinn group has 9 engineers.",
    "Backups are checked every Friday."
  ),
  question = c(
    "Which year did the Field team start?",
    "How long do replacement parts take?",
    "How many engineers are in Tallinn?",
    "Which weekday are backups checked?"
  ),
  answer = c("2016", "3 business days", "9", "Friday")
)

find_evidence <- module(
  signature(
    "context, question -> evidence: string",
    instructions = "Quote the supplied context as evidence."
  ),
  template = "Question: {question}\nContext: {context}\nEvidence:"
)
answer_from_evidence <- module(
  signature(
    "evidence -> answer: string",
    instructions = "Return the first word of the evidence as the answer."
  ),
  template = "Evidence: {evidence}\nAnswer:"
)
qa_program <- pipeline(find_evidence, answer_from_evidence)

metric <- metric_with_feedback(
  function(prediction, expected) {
    correct <- identical(prediction$answer, expected$answer)
    list(
      score = as.numeric(correct),
      feedback = if (correct) {
        "Correct."
      } else {
        paste0(
          "Expected '", expected$answer, "' but got '",
          prediction$answer, "'. Preserve the full value."
        )
      }
    )
  },
  field = "answer"
)
```

`named_parameters()` reveals the exact module paths a harness is allowed to
edit—here `$/steps/1` and `$/steps/2`, each exposing `instructions` and
`template`. Any proposal targeting an unlisted path or field is rejected before
evaluation:

```{r}
#| label: editable-paths
names(named_parameters(qa_program, include_root = TRUE, boundaries = "respect"))
```

```{r}
#| label: offline-setup
#| include: false
fixture_file <- system.file(
  "examples",
  "agentic-optimization-harnesses.R",
  package = "dsprrr",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
source(fixture_file, local = TRUE)

auto_agent_audit <- new_offline_audit()
auto_script <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
auto_script$next_action <- 0L
auto_actions <- list(
  action_propose(
    "Extract evidence first; this tests whether the answer step can use it.",
    list(candidate(
      "evidence-only",
      "The downstream step may still truncate a multiword value.",
      list(edit_evidence_only)
    ))
  ),
  action_propose(
    "The answer step must preserve the complete extracted value.",
    list(candidate(
      "coordinated-pipeline",
      "Update the evidence and answer contracts together.",
      list(edit_evidence_only, edit_answer)
    ))
  )
)
auto_agent <- new_offline_chat(
  "offline-autoresearch-proposer",
  function(prompt, type, ...) {
    auto_script$next_action <- auto_script$next_action + 1L
    auto_actions[[auto_script$next_action]]
  },
  auto_agent_audit
)

meta_agent_audit <- new_offline_audit()
meta_script <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
meta_script$next_action <- 0L
meta_actions <- list(
  action_propose(
    "Compare a local evidence edit with a coordinated answer contract.",
    list(
      candidate(
        "evidence-only",
        "This candidate leaves the answer step's first-word rule in place.",
        list(edit_evidence_only)
      ),
      candidate(
        "coordinated-pipeline",
        "Keep the complete multiword evidence through the second step.",
        list(edit_evidence_only, edit_answer)
      )
    )
  ),
  action_propose(
    "The winning contract works; test a harmless output label change.",
    list(candidate(
      "coordinated-format-variant",
      "Retain the full evidence value with a different final label.",
      list(list(
        path = "$/steps/2",
        template = paste("Evidence block:", "{evidence}", "Return the full value:", sep = "\n")
      ))
    ))
  )
)
meta_agent <- new_offline_chat(
  "offline-meta-harness-proposer",
  function(prompt, type, session_id, prior_turns, ...) {
    meta_script$next_action <- meta_script$next_action + 1L
    meta_agent_audit$proposer_prompts <- append(
      meta_agent_audit$proposer_prompts %||% list(),
      list(list(session_id = session_id, prior_turns = prior_turns, prompt = prompt))
    )
    meta_actions[[meta_script$next_action]]
  },
  meta_agent_audit
)
meta_agent$set_turns(list(list(role = "user", content = "stale source turn")))

compare_on_split <- function(base_mod, opt_mod, data) {
  b <- evaluate(base_mod, data, metric = metric, .llm = task_chat, .cache = FALSE, .progress = FALSE)
  o <- evaluate(opt_mod, data, metric = metric, .llm = task_chat, .cache = FALSE, .progress = FALSE)
  list(
    before = b$mean_score,
    after = o$mean_score,
    rows = data.frame(
      question = data$question,
      expected = data$answer,
      baseline = vapply(b$predictions, `[[`, character(1), "answer"),
      optimized = vapply(o$predictions, `[[`, character(1), "answer"),
      score = o$scores
    )
  )
}
```

## 2. `AutoResearch()`: one persistent research session

`AutoResearch()` evaluates the baseline, then runs one persistent proposer
session. Here, iteration 1 edits only `$/steps/1` (reaching `0.75` on `valset`
because `"7 business days"` still truncates), and iteration 2 coordinates both
steps to hit `target_score = 1`:

```{r}
#| label: autoresearch-run
auto_compiled <- compile(
  qa_program,
  AutoResearch(
    metric = metric,
    max_iterations = 2L,
    patience = 2L,
    target_score = 1,
    seed = 42L,
    sandbox = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  ),
  trainset,
  valset = valset,
  .llm = task_chat,
  .agent_llm = auto_agent,
  control = optimizer_control(
    max_trials = 4L,
    max_metric_calls = 20L,
    max_provider_calls = 40L,
    progress = FALSE
  ),
  .cache = FALSE,
  objective = "Answer from the context and preserve the complete value."
)

auto_result <- optimization_result(auto_compiled)
auto_result$trials[, c("id", "parent_id", "name", "iteration", "score", "selected", "status")]
auto_result$stop_reason
```

Checking the compiled pipeline on the untouched `holdout` rows confirms the
coordinated edit generalizes beyond `valset`:

```{r}
#| label: autoresearch-holdout
auto_holdout <- compare_on_split(qa_program, auto_compiled, holdout)
auto_holdout$rows
c(baseline = auto_holdout$before, optimized = auto_holdout$after)
```

## 3. `MetaHarness()`: fresh proposers over a scored frontier

`MetaHarness()` clones and resets `.agent_llm` before every outer iteration, so
each proposer reasons cleanly from the persisted frontier rather than from long
chat history, and submits a batch of candidates (`max_candidates_per_iteration`):

```{r}
#| label: meta-harness-run
meta_compiled <- compile(
  qa_program,
  MetaHarness(
    metric = metric,
    max_iterations = 2L,
    max_candidates_per_iteration = 2L,
    frontier_size = 2L,
    patience = 3L,
    seed = 42L,
    sandbox = FALSE,
    verbose = FALSE
  ),
  trainset,
  valset = valset,
  .llm = task_chat,
  .agent_llm = meta_agent,
  control = optimizer_control(
    max_trials = 5L,
    max_metric_calls = 24L,
    max_provider_calls = 50L,
    progress = FALSE
  ),
  .cache = FALSE,
  objective = "Answer from the context and preserve the complete value."
)

meta_result <- optimization_result(meta_compiled)
meta_result$trials[, c("id", "parent_id", "name", "iteration", "score", "selected", "status")]
meta_result$extensions$meta_harness$frontier_ids
```

In iteration 1, the proposer tests both `evidence-only` (`0.75`) and
`coordinated-pipeline` (`1.00`) in one batch; in iteration 2, a fresh proposer
sees the frontier and explores a formatting variant branching from the winner.
On `holdout`, the selected program again rises from `0` to `1`:

```{r}
#| label: meta-harness-holdout
meta_holdout <- compare_on_split(qa_program, meta_compiled, holdout)
c(baseline = meta_holdout$before, optimized = meta_holdout$after)
```

```{r}
#| label: verify-invariants
#| include: false
auto_trials <- auto_result$trials
auto_sessions <- vapply(auto_agent_audit$calls, `[[`, character(1), "session_id")
auto_prompts <- paste(vapply(auto_agent_audit$calls, `[[`, character(1), "prompt"), collapse = "\n")

meta_trials <- meta_result$trials
meta_sessions <- vapply(meta_agent_audit$proposer_prompts, `[[`, character(1), "session_id")
meta_prior <- vapply(meta_agent_audit$proposer_prompts, `[[`, integer(1), "prior_turns")
meta_prompts <- paste(vapply(meta_agent_audit$proposer_prompts, `[[`, character(1), "prompt"), collapse = "\n")

stopifnot(
  auto_result$baseline_score == 0,
  auto_trials$score[auto_trials$name == "evidence-only"] == 0.75,
  auto_result$best_score == 1,
  auto_trials$selected[auto_trials$name == "coordinated-pipeline"],
  length(unique(auto_sessions)) == 1L,
  identical(auto_result$stop_reason, "target_score"),
  auto_holdout$before == 0 && auto_holdout$after == 1,
  !any(vapply(holdout$context, grepl, logical(1), x = auto_prompts, fixed = TRUE)),
  meta_result$baseline_score == 0,
  meta_trials$score[meta_trials$name == "evidence-only"] == 0.75,
  meta_trials$score[meta_trials$name == "coordinated-pipeline"] == 1,
  meta_trials$selected[meta_trials$name == "coordinated-pipeline"],
  length(meta_result$extensions$meta_harness$frontier_ids) == 2L,
  identical(meta_result$stop_reason, "max_iterations"),
  length(unique(meta_sessions)) == 2L,
  all(meta_prior == 0L),
  length(meta_agent$turns) == 1L,
  meta_holdout$before == 0 && meta_holdout$after == 1,
  !any(vapply(holdout$context, grepl, logical(1), x = meta_prompts, fixed = TRUE))
)
```

## 4. Sandbox and trust boundaries

With the default `sandbox = TRUE`, exploratory R analyses requested by the
proposer must run in a runner that advertises a verified OS sandbox—specifically
`mcp_repl_runner()`, which launches Posit's
[mcp-console](https://github.com/posit-dev/mcp-console) with network access
disabled and writes restricted to the workspace (`workspace-write`). User-managed
`repl =` connections and `r_code_runner()` are rejected when `sandbox = TRUE`.

| Limit | Bound | Behavior when exceeded |
|---|---|---|
| Exploratory R code per action | 12,000 characters | Action rejected without running |
| Sandbox output shown to the agent | 4,000 characters | Truncated and marked `[truncated]` |
| Editable fields | Leaf `instructions` & `template` only | Unknown paths/fields rejected before evaluation |
| Evaluation & selection | Host R process only | Agent never modifies R source or the metric |

## 5. Run live with a sandboxed runner

Install `mcptools` and `posit-mcp-repl`, pair a fast task Chat (`.llm`) with a
strong proposer Chat (`.agent_llm`), and set explicit `optimizer_control()`
caps:

```{r}
#| label: live-model-run
#| eval: false
task_chat <- ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-6-luna")
proposer_chat <- ellmer::chat_anthropic(model = "claude-sonnet-4-5")
runner <- mcp_repl_runner(sandbox = "workspace-write", timeout = 30)

# Option A: persistent session with AutoResearch()
auto_live <- compile(
  qa_program,
  AutoResearch(metric = metric, max_iterations = 4L, target_score = 1),
  trainset,
  valset = valset,
  .llm = task_chat,
  .agent_llm = proposer_chat,
  runner = runner,
  control = optimizer_control(
    max_trials = 5L,
    max_metric_calls = 20L,
    max_provider_calls = 50L,
    max_cost = 5,
    checkpoint_path = file.path(tempdir(), "autoresearch-checkpoint.rds")
  ),
  objective = "Answer from supplied evidence and preserve complete values."
)

# Option B: fresh proposers per iteration with MetaHarness()
meta_live <- compile(
  qa_program,
  MetaHarness(
    metric = metric,
    max_iterations = 4L,
    max_candidates_per_iteration = 3L,
    frontier_size = 4L
  ),
  trainset,
  valset = valset,
  .llm = task_chat,
  .agent_llm = proposer_chat,
  runner = runner,
  control = optimizer_control(
    max_trials = 10L,
    max_metric_calls = 40L,
    max_provider_calls = 80L,
    max_cost = 5,
    checkpoint_path = file.path(tempdir(), "metaharness-checkpoint.rds")
  ),
  objective = "Answer from supplied evidence and preserve complete values."
)

optimization_result(auto_live)
```

Checkpoints restore the optimizer ledger, frontier, and RNG state (not live
Chats or runner processes). To combine either harness with other teleprompters
in one search, see [Compose optimizers with Omni](omni-meta-optimization.html).
